nature: internal AI-assisted engineering review; NOT an independent audit

findings.TITLE: Consensus RPC routes fail open without bound peer auth (AUD-008) incl. CLI loopback-behind-trusted-proxy variant
findings.PROOF: l1/test/crypto-review-rpc-consensus-auth.test.ts: 3/6 failed before fix (proxied consensus reached handler; direct non-loopback reached handler; assertSafeRpcBinding(127.0.0.1,false,true) did not throw)
findings.FIX: Consensus routes served without bound auth only to direct loopback callers with no trusted proxy; explicit allowUnauthenticatedConsensus opt-in; assertSafeRpcBinding rejects trusted proxy without consensus auth

findings.TITLE: Mining mint path still live at protocol v5 for any genesis < 50M; fixed-supply retirement relied only on schedule remaining=0
findings.PROOF: Existing l1/test/mining.test.ts mints 6.25 ZYN on small genesis at v5; l1/test/crypto-review-fixed-supply.test.ts 2/7 failed before explicit guard (claim was already refused via schedule, message-level)
findings.FIX: assertMiningClaimContext rejects all claims when genesis supply >= MAX before schedule/PoW; explicit genesis+issued+reward <= MAX check from consensus counters
findings.STATUS: PARTIALLY FIXED (unconditional retirement requires consensus/product decision with #913)

findings.TITLE: Transaction Merkle odd-node duplication (CVE-2012-2459 class); header does not commit to tx count
findings.PROOF: l1/test/crypto-review-merkle-duplicate.test.ts: validateBlockEnvelope accepted [a,b,c,c] with identical hash/signatures before fix
findings.FIX: Reject duplicate txids in validateBlockEnvelope; recommend domain-tagged leaves/nodes + tx count at next protocol version

findings.TITLE: Telegram initData non-ASCII hash raises TypeError (HTTP 500) and bypasses auth-failure rate limit
findings.FIX: Require lowercase-hex hash; compare ASCII bytes with hmac.compare_digest

findings.TITLE: Protocol v1/v2 consensus signatures are not domain-separated
findings.PROOF: l1/test/crypto-review-signatures.test.ts proves signed payload key-sets pairwise distinct
findings.FIX: None needed now; keep new message types domain-tagged (v3+ already)

findings.TITLE: #913 assertFixedSupplyGenesis accepts activityPool = founder or liquidity reserve; oracle can drain it in one settlement
findings.PROOF: Probe against pr-913: validator accepted, oracle drain admitted to mempool for both roles; suggestion test fails before fix
findings.FIX: Pin activityPool to publicDistribution or ecosystemReserve (branch audit/crypto-review-20260930-pr913-suggestions)

findings.TITLE: #913 founder vesting and permanent liquidity are not enforced on-chain
findings.PROOF: founder-vesting.ts is arithmetic only; genesis keys can spend full allocations (acknowledged in #913 docs)
findings.FIX: Protocol-level lock or audited custody construction before any value-bearing launch

findings.TITLE: #913 block-height vesting assumes 30s cadence not enforced by consensus
findings.PROOF: Consensus only requires increasing timestamps (<= +120s future)
findings.FIX: Vest by finalized timestamp or enforce minimum block interval
